data.exact_reserve_text: The 2012 account includes the movement in the 2007 to 2011 accounts which have closed into the 2012 account. At thirty-six months the account has produced both a pure and prior year underwriting profit together with a small amount of investment income. Overall the result is a profit of GBP 2.7 million which is 9% of a stamp capacity of GBP 30 million. The overall calendar year result is the aggregate of the calendar year results of all years of account. The results are all from continuing operations. The annual accounting result is a profit of GBP 1.7 million before currency translation differences in the year (2013: loss GBP 2.0 million) and this can be analysed as follows: [table values for Profit/(loss) for the financial year: 2012* account 3,644; 2013 account 4,608]

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net prior year release of GBP 8.252 million for the 2014 financial year, primarily driven by favorable development on the 2012 and 2013 underwriting accounts, as well as older closed years (2007-2011) which were included in the 2012 account. A specific long-running disputed claim from the 2011 underwriting year was settled, contributing to a satisfactory reserve release.
